title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
summary: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads. (source: IMDb)

reception.director: Joaquim Dos Santos, Kemp Powers, Justin K. Thompson
reception.actors: Shameik Moore, Hailee Steinfeld, Brian Tyree Henry, Luna Lauren Velez, Oscar Isaac
reception.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 92 wins & 144 nominations total.
